_readme: One case per screenshot in knowledge/examples/. Run `npm run cases:sync` after adding screenshots to create stubs. Fill in trade details and expected_grade_range, then set expected_range_status to COACH CONFIRMED. Cases with source 'fixture' are synthetic pipeline checks, not coaching examples.

cases.details_source: Synthetic chart drawn by the build script: candles read as down, down, inside bar, then up breaks. Prices are invented.

trade.notes: 2-1-2 reversal. Higher timeframes green (FTFC). Entered on the break of the inside bar high, stop under the inside bar low, target the previous candle high. Followed my plan.

cases.why: Textbook process described in the notes with 3 to 1 reward and 0.4 percent risk. Best guess by the assistant.
